integrity.claim_scope: Binary two-channel nearest-neighbor F_2 rules; general Laurent rank-two criterion with published assumptions.
integrity.verification: Two complete and independently represented finite enumerators, with a separate analytic reduction of the general criteria.

scientific_limitations: The entropy and strong-transitivity criteria are deduced from explicitly cited general theorems; the newly evaluated contribution is the joint 256-rule census with onsite-basis orbit refinement.
The rank-two criterion is a specialization of the published spectral criterion and is not asserted to be a new general characterization.
The 56 orbits are under simultaneous onsite GL_2(F_2) conjugation, not arbitrary dynamical topological conjugacy.
Unindexed or inaccessible earlier numerical classifications remain a possible originality risk; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A factorization-free rank-two test and the complete entropy–transitivity census of binary two-channel cellular automata
